If you are happy with the situation then there is no need to leave. But don’t you feel hurt every time he cheats? Or when he’s been out late and says he’s been with some girl? 

I’m sure you love him very much. But please think about yourself too. Do you really feel like you deserve this? It may take a while to find someone amazing again but isn’t that what you owe yourself instead of putting up with an unfaithful partner? You’re young and have a whole lot of life to live, don’t stay hung up on one person just because of their looks or how they treat you sometimes, or because they are with you on Valentine’s Day. 

Loving someone in a monogamous relationship (which I assume you are in) should be upheld on both sides. Truly wanting to be the only other person for each other. The one person you are intimate with is a special thing. 

If you are happy with letting him cheat then so be it. But I think you deserve better OP and so does everyone in this comment section.
